note: The deal-desk baseline compliance index is fixed from the lab reference book's own question — in the molecule containing sodium atoms, how many are non-carcinogenic (count the DISTINCT molecules that contain a sodium atom and are labelled non-carcinogenic).
The independent side-region FX exposure for the quarterly overview — what percentage of KAM-segment customers pay in euros (the euro-paying share of KAM customers).
The delegation bar is set at 1000 per index point.

The flagged non-standard-deal count is taken from the pipeline registry's own question — how many users with more than 10 views created their account after 2013 (count the accounts joined after 2013 with more than 10 views) — and set the aggregate discount impact at 100 per flagged deal.
The total exposure is the bar plus the impact; the escalation delta equals the impact.

The routing branch is decided on the impact against the bar — 'AUTO_APPROVE' when the impact is at most the bar, 'MULTI_LEVEL_APPROVE' when it is at most three times the bar, 'ESCALATE_TO_CEO' otherwise

The QBR review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the approval window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
